repositories.types.hosted: Keeps your own components and artifacts in a private local repository, for internal builds and your own software.
repositories.types.proxy: Caches components of a remote registry such as Maven Central or npmjs.org. Builds get faster and components stay available while the remote is down.
repositories.types.group: Puts several repositories, hosted and proxy, behind one URL, so users get every component from one entry point.
repositories.create.title: Create Repository
repositories.create.filter: Search technologies (for example Docker, npm, Maven)...
repositories.create.noneText: Your account may not create repositories of any format this server offers.
repositories.create.unknown: This kind of repository cannot be created here
repositories.create.unknownText: The server offers no {format} {type} repositories, or your account may not create them.
repositories.form.sections.domainText: Serve this repository on a domain of its own as well. The address under /repository/ keeps working.
repositories.form.sections.terraformText: How Terraform reaches this repository and who may read it
repositories.form.sections.cargoText: Who can read the content of this Cargo registry
repositories.form.sections.nixText: What the repository tells Nix in its nix-cache-info file
repositories.form.sections.aptSigningTex: GPG signing of the APT repository
repositories.form.aptDistributionHint: The distribution to serve or fetch, for example bookworm or jammy, or the path of a flat repository
repositories.form.aptEnforceDistribution: Serve only the distribution named below
repositories.form.aptFlatHint: The remote repository has no dists/ hierarchy of distributions
repositories.form.aptKeypairHint: The GPG signing key pair in ASCII armor, for example the output of gpg --export-secret-key --armor
repositories.form.aptKeypairStored: A signing key is stored and never shown; leave this empty to keep it or paste a new one
repositories.form.aptPassphraseHint: The passphrase of the GPG key; leave it empty when the key has none
repositories.form.sections.alpineSigning: Signs the APKINDEX.tar.gz files with an RSA key; clients save the public key {key} from the root of the repository into /etc/apk/keys
Signs the merged APKINDEX.tar.gz files with an RSA key, published as {key}; without a key the group passes the signed index of a single member through and leaves a merge of several unsigned
repositories.form.alpineKeypairHint: A PEM-encoded RSA private key, for example the output of openssl genrsa 4096 or abuild-keygen; leave it empty for unsigned indexes
repositories.form.alpineKeypairStored: A signing key is stored and never shown; leave this empty to keep it or paste a new one
repositories.form.alpinePassphraseHint: The passphrase of an encrypted key; leave it empty when the key has none
repositories.form.sections.hexSigningTex: Signs names, versions and packages of the registry with an RSA key; clients check them with the public key served as public_key at the root of the repository
repositories.form.hexKeypairHint: A PEM-encoded RSA private key without a passphrase, for example the key of the server this repository moves from; leave it empty and a key is made when the registry is first read
repositories.form.hexKeypairStored: A signing key is stored and never shown; leave this empty to keep it. A new key needs the new public key on every client
repositories.form.sections.pacmanSigning: Signs the .db and .files databases with an OpenPGP key, served next to them as .db.sig and .files.sig; clients import the public key {key} from the root of the repository with pacman-key
Signs the databases the group serves with an OpenPGP key, published as {key}; without a key the group passes the signature of a single member through and leaves a merge of several unsigned
repositories.form.pacmanKeypairHint: An ASCII-armored OpenPGP private key, for example the output of gpg --export-secret-key --armor; leave it empty for unsigned databases
repositories.form.pacmanKeypairStored: A signing key is stored and never shown; leave this empty to keep it or paste a new one
repositories.form.pacmanPassphraseHint: The passphrase of the signing key; leave it empty when the key has none
repositories.form.sections.conanText: The Conan protocol of the remote
repositories.form.conanVersionHint: Conan 1 repositories cannot be moved to Conan 2 automatically, so the version is fixed once the repository exists.
repositories.form.sections.terraformSign: The PGP key that signs the checksums of providers uploaded without a signature of their own
repositories.form.name: Name
repositories.form.nameHint: A unique identifier of the repository
repositories.form.blobStoreHint: The blob store that keeps the content of the repository
repositories.form.blobStoreFixed: The blob store cannot be changed after creation
repositories.form.strictHint: Check that the MIME type of everything uploaded matches the format of the repository
repositories.form.writePolicyHint: Whether artifacts may be published and updated
repositories.form.remoteUrlHint: Address of the remote repository to proxy. {example}
repositories.form.remoteUrlHintNuget: The URL to proxy. NuGet V2, NuGet V3 and Chocolatey work, for example https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json
repositories.form.contentMaxAgeHint: Minutes to cache artifacts before the remote is checked again. -1 turns caching off.
repositories.form.metadataMaxAgeHint: Minutes to cache metadata before the remote is checked again.
repositories.form.queryCacheItemMaxAgeHi: How long to cache query results from the proxied repository (in seconds)
repositories.form.nixStoreDirHint: The Nix store the binary cache is for, /nix/store unless the clients use another store. Uploaded narinfo files must name store paths in it.
repositories.form.nixPriorityHint: Nix asks the substituters with lower numbers first; cache.nixos.org has 40.
repositories.form.nixWantMassQueryHint: Nix may ask this repository for many store paths at once, for example when it lists what it can substitute.
repositories.form.registryHostHint: The host name (with a port if needed) Terraform configurations use for this repository, as in <host>/<namespace>/<name>/<system>. The server answers service discovery at https://<host>/.well-known/terraform.json with this repository. Leave empty to reach the repository by its own URL only.
repositories.form.upstreamHostHint: The host name the providers of the remote registry carry in their addresses, which the provider network mirror protocol names. Leave empty to take it from the remote URL; set it, for example to registry.terraform.io, when the remote is itself a mirror of that registry.
repositories.form.requireAuthentication: Show the repository content to signed-in users only
repositories.form.requireAuthenticationH: When unchecked, anonymous users can read the repository only while anonymous access is on for the server
repositories.form.signingKeypairHint: PGP signing key pair (an armored secret key, for example from gpg --export-secret-key --armor)
repositories.form.signingPassphraseHint: Passphrase of the PGP signing key (leave empty when the key has none). It is never shown again after saving.
repositories.form.signingPassphraseEditH: The stored passphrase is never shown. Leave the field empty to keep it while the signing key stays the same, or enter a new one.
repositories.form.sections.yumText: Where the repository generates repodata and what it accepts
repositories.form.sections.yumSigningTex: Signs repodata/repomd.xml so that clients with repo_gpgcheck can verify it; the public key is served at repodata/repomd.xml.key
repositories.form.repodataDepthHint: How many directories below the repository root the repodata is generated, from 0 (the root) to 5
repositories.form.deployPolicyHint: Strict accepts only RPM packages at or below the repodata depth; permissive accepts any file at any path
repositories.form.yumKeypairHint: An ASCII-armored PGP private key, for example the output of gpg --export-secret-key --armor
repositories.form.yumKeypairStored: A signing key is stored and never shown; leave this empty to keep it or paste a new one
repositories.form.yumPassphraseHint: The passphrase of the signing key; leave it empty when the key has none
repositories.form.negativeCacheEnabledHi: Cache answers about content the remote does not have
repositories.form.blockedHint: Block outbound connections of the repository
repositories.form.autoBlockHint: Block outbound connections automatically while the remote is unreachable or does not answer
repositories.form.retriesHint: How many times to retry when the first connection attempt times out
repositories.form.timeoutHint: Seconds to wait for activity before the connection is dropped and retried
repositories.form.userAgentSuffixHint: Your own text appended to the User-Agent header
repositories.form.preemptiveHint: Careful: use only when you must. Credentials are sent to the remote URL even when the remote did not ask for them.
repositories.form.membersHint: Choose the repositories of this group. The order sets the search priority.
repositories.form.writableMemberHint: The member repository that receives POST and PUT requests
repositories.form.versionPolicyHint: Which kind of artifacts may be published to this repository
repositories.form.layoutPolicyHint: Check that every path is a Maven artifact or metadata path
repositories.form.forceBasicAuthHint: Require authentication even with anonymous access (pulls need docker login)
repositories.form.subdomainHint: Reach this Docker repository through this subdomain. Works only behind a reverse proxy that routes by subdomain.
repositories.form.domainHostHint: A domain name such as docker.example.com. Point its DNS A record at this server and send it here from the reverse proxy; the repository is saved even before DNS is ready.
repositories.form.domainRoutingHint: The whole domain belongs to this repository, or several repositories share it, each under its own path.
repositories.form.domainPathHint: The first path segment that leads to this repository, such as prod. Empty means the repository name. Each path is used once on a domain.
repositories.form.domainCheck.unknown: {host} points to {addresses}. The address of this server is not known, so check that it is this server.
repositories.form.domainCheck.missing: {host} has no A record yet. The repository is saved anyway; the domain works once its DNS points to this server.
repositories.form.domainCheck.other: {host} points to {addresses}, but this server is at {server}. The repository is saved anyway; the domain works once its DNS points here.
repositories.form.domainCheck.saved: Saved, but the domain does not lead here yet
repositories.form.indexTypes.REGISTRY: Use the proxied registry (the remote URL)
repositories.form.cacheForeignLayers: Allow Astrum Repository Manager to download and cache foreign layers
repositories.form.cacheForeignLayersHint: Cache layers kept on another server in this proxy repository
repositories.form.foreignLayerUrlWhiteli: Regular expressions for allowed foreign layer URLs, one per line. Leave empty to allow all.
repositories.form.readOnly: You can read these settings but not change them.
repositories.form.errors.namePattern: Use letters, digits, '-', '_' and '.'; the name cannot start with '_' or '.'
repositories.form.errors.terraformHost: Enter a host name, with a :port if needed, without https:// and a path
repositories.form.errors.nixStoreDir: Enter an absolute directory such as /nix/store, without a trailing slash
repositories.form.errors.domainHost: Enter a domain name such as docker.example.com, without https://, a port or a path
repositories.form.errors.domainPath: Use one segment of letters, digits, '-', '_' and '.', other than v2, repository and service
repositories.form.errors.remoteUrlRequir: Enter the address of the remote repository
repositories.form.errors.urlInvalid: Enter an http:// or https:// address with a host
repositories.form.errors.maxAge: Enter a whole number of minutes, or -1
repositories.form.errors.timeToLive: Enter a whole number of minutes, 0 or more
repositories.form.errors.queryCacheItemM: Enter a whole number of seconds, 0 or more
repositories.form.errors.repodataDepth: Enter a whole number from 0 to 5
repositories.form.errors.retries: Enter a whole number from 0 to 10
repositories.form.errors.timeout: Enter a whole number of seconds from 1 to 3600
repositories.form.errors.portsDiffer: Use another port than the HTTP port
repositories.form.errors.indexUrlRequire: Enter the address of the index
repositories.edit.notFound: There is no repository named {name}, or you cannot see it.
repositories.delete.title: Delete {name}?
repositories.delete.hosted: The repository is removed with every component and asset published to it, and their files in the blob store.
repositories.delete.proxy: The repository is removed with everything it cached, and the files in the blob store. The remote repository is not touched.
repositories.delete.group: The group and its address are removed. Its members and their content stay.
repositories.delete.groups: It is also taken out of these groups: {groups}.
repositories.audit.title: Recent Activity
repositories.audit.label: Recent events of the repository
repositories.list.healthCheckUnavailable: Repository Health Check is not available on this server.
repositories.list.loadFailed: The repositories could not be loaded
repositories.list.aboutText: A repository is where software components are stored, organised and fetched from. Hosted repositories keep your own artifacts, proxy repositories cache remote content, and group repositories put several repositories behind one URL.
repositories.actions.offlineText: Take "{name}" offline? Clients cannot read from it or write to it until it is brought online again.
repositories.actions.onlineText: Bring "{name}" online? Clients can reach it again.
repositories.actions.invalidateText: Invalidate the cached metadata and content of "{name}"? Later requests fetch them from upstream again.
repositories.actions.rebuildText: Rebuild the search index of "{name}"? Depending on its size this can take a while.
repositories.actions.copyFailed: The URL could not be copied to the clipboard
repositories.form.authTypeHint: How to authenticate against the remote repository
repositories.form.cleanupHint: Choose the cleanup policies of this repository
repositories.form.cleanupText: Cleanup policies delete components from this repository automatically.
repositories.form.enableCircularRedirect: Allow redirects to the same address
repositories.form.enableCookiesHint: Allow cookies to be kept and sent
repositories.form.httpPortHint: Open an HTTP connector on this port. Usually needed behind a reverse proxy.
repositories.form.httpsPortHint: Open an HTTPS connector on this port. Usually needed without a reverse proxy.
repositories.form.inlineWarning: Served inline, uploaded HTML renders on the trusted Astrum URL, which can be abused for phishing other users.
repositories.form.mavenDispositionHint: Sets the Content-Disposition header to "Attachment" so browsers download files instead of showing them.
repositories.form.rawDispositionHint: Whether content is shown in the browser or downloaded as an attachment
repositories.form.nameFixed: The repository name cannot be changed
repositories.form.preserveEncodedHint: When checked, encoded characters such as %2B (plus), %23 (hash) and %20 (space) reach the remote still encoded. Turn it on when proxying AWS S3, Cloudflare CDN or Azure Blob Storage.
repositories.form.proprietaryHint: Components of this repository count as proprietary for Firewall
repositories.form.routingModeHint: Path routing puts the repository name into the URL path. Connectors use their own ports or subdomains.
repositories.form.routingRuleHint: The routing rule of this repository
repositories.form.sections.dockerIndexTe: How this proxy repository reaches the index of the Docker registry
repositories.form.sections.routingText: Choose a rule so that this repository does not serve some requests.
repositories.form.timeToLiveHint: Minutes to remember that a file is missing from the remote
repositories.form.useTrustStoreHint: Use certificates from the Astrum Repository truststore for connections to external systems
repositories.form.v1EnabledHint: Let clients use this repository through the V1 API
repositories.summary.label: Repository summary
repositories.summary.name: Name
repositories.audit.emptyText: Nothing about this repository was audited in the last 30 days.
repositories.tasks.title: Scheduled Tasks
repositories.tasks.empty: No scheduled tasks target this repository.
repositories.tasks.noCapabilities: No capabilities are tied to this repository.
repositories.access.noPrivileges: No privileges refer to this repository.
repositories.access.noRoles: No role includes the privileges of this repository.
repositories.access.noUsers: No user has access through the roles of this repository.
repositories.access.anonymousNo: Anonymous users cannot reach this repository.
repositories.access.anonymousYes: Anonymous users can reach this repository.
repositories.access.alsoOther: also through wider privileges or other roles
repositories.access.removeRoleText: {user} loses the role {role} and everything it grants, not only access to this repository.
repositories.access.anonymousServerOff: Anonymous access is turned off for the whole server.
repositories.access.anonymousOffTitle: Close the repository to anonymous users?
repositories.access.anonymousOffText: The privileges of this repository are removed from these roles: {roles}.
repositories.access.anonymousOffShared: The privileges of this repository are removed from these roles: {roles}. The users {users} hold them too and lose access as well.
repositories.access.anonymousOnTitle: Open the repository to anonymous users?
repositories.access.anonymousOnText: Anonymous users get read access through the role {role}.
repositories.access.anonymousBlockedTitl: Anonymous access cannot be closed here
repositories.access.anonymousBlocked: Anonymous users reach this repository through these roles: {roles}. They grant it with privileges for many repositories or through other roles, so change them on the Roles page.
repositories.formats.ansible: Collections of Ansible modules, plugins and roles, served through the Galaxy API.
repositories.formats.apt: The package tool of Debian and Ubuntu distributions.
repositories.formats.chef: Chef Infra cookbooks, served through the Supermarket API to Berkshelf, Policyfiles and knife.
repositories.formats.cocoapods: Dependency manager for Swift and Objective-C projects.
repositories.formats.conan: Open-source package manager for C and C++ development.
repositories.formats.conda: Manages packages, dependencies and environments for any language.
repositories.formats.go: Module proxy and registry for Go.
repositories.formats.docker: Container images and any other OCI artifacts: Helm charts, signatures, SBOMs, Wasm modules, AI models.
repositories.formats.gitlfs: Git Large File Storage for versioning large files.
repositories.formats.hex: Packages for Elixir and Erlang, served to Mix and rebar3 with a signed registry.
repositories.formats.maven2: The standard of Java development, with snapshots and releases.
repositories.formats.nix: Binary cache for Nix: store paths pushed with nix copy and fetched by substituters.
repositories.formats.npm: Package manager for JavaScript and Node.js.
repositories.formats.openvsx: VS Code extensions for VSCodium and other editors, served through the Open VSX and gallery APIs.
repositories.formats.pacman: The package manager of Arch Linux and the distributions built on it.
repositories.formats.pub: Packages for Dart and Flutter, served to dart pub and flutter pub.
repositories.formats.puppet: Modules of Puppet code, served through the Forge API to puppet module install, r10k and Bolt.
repositories.formats.pypi: The official third-party software repository for Python.
repositories.formats.r: Packages for R, served in the layout of CRAN.
repositories.formats.raw: Files of any format, without metadata requirements.
repositories.formats.rubygems: The standard package manager for Ruby.
repositories.formats.turbo: A remote cache for Turborepo: task outputs that turbo run uploads and restores, kept apart per team.
repositories.formats.vagrant: Boxes for Vagrant, with the version metadata that vagrant box add, outdated and update read.
repositories.formats.yum: The main package manager of RPM-based Linux distributions.
